capabilities.name: identification.symbol_generation
capabilities.description: Declares symbol generation only; it neither reads a symbol nor verifies printed quality.

symbologies.description: Supported symbol symbologies, initially qr_code and data_matrix.

content_profiles.description: Content-profile identifiers this configuration can generate, such as opaque_payload, gs1_element_string, or gs1_digital_link_uri.

min_module_width.description: Minimum module width this configuration can generate.

max_module_width.description: Maximum module width this configuration can generate.

minimum_quiet_zone_modules.description: Minimum quiet-zone width this configuration can generate, expressed in whole or fractional module widths.

capabilities.name: identification.symbol_reading
capabilities.description: Declares symbol reading only. A successful read is not a quality-verification or certification assertion.

symbologies.description: Symbol symbologies this configuration can read, initially qr_code and data_matrix.

content_profiles.description: Content-profile identifiers this configuration can read, such as opaque_payload, gs1_element_string, or gs1_digital_link_uri.

min_module_width.description: Minimum module width this configuration can read.

max_module_width.description: Maximum module width this configuration can read.

minimum_quiet_zone_modules.description: Minimum quiet-zone width this configuration can read, expressed in whole or fractional module widths.

capabilities.name: identification.quality_verification
capabilities.description: Declares the ability to perform a named quality-verification method. It does not issue, authenticate, or certify a quality claim.

symbologies.description: Symbol symbologies covered by the declared verification methods.

quality_methods.description: Named verification methods, such as iso_iec_15415, without asserting a result or certificate.

content_profiles.description: Content-profile identifiers covered by this verification configuration, such as opaque_payload, gs1_element_string, or gs1_digital_link_uri.

min_module_width.description: Minimum module width covered by this verification configuration.

max_module_width.description: Maximum module width covered by this verification configuration.

minimum_quiet_zone_modules.description: Minimum quiet-zone width covered by this verification configuration, expressed in whole or fractional module widths.
